Name: Milktosis
Author: Imbion
TagLine: Turn large milk into some regular milk, with configurable balance options.
Description:
For when you don't need a massive jug of milk for that omelette you're making. Because that would be wasteful.

___Requirements:___
SMAPI & Content Patcher

___What it does:___
Adds a configurable crafting recipe that unlocks at Farming level 4, which allows you to craft large milk into more regular milk. Works for goat milk as well.

___Config Options:___
* Can individually select different balance modes for Goat Milk and Cow Milk.
* Divide: Convert one large milk into two milk.
* Hardwood: Conversion recipe also costs two hardwood. (Default)
* Refined Quartz: Conversion recipe also costs one refined quartz.
* Price Neutral: Convert two large milk into three milks.
* Disabled: Add no crafting recipe.
